newsitem.title: USA: Citadel Tech sees lower Q2 sales.
newsitem.headline: Citadel Tech sees lower Q2 sales.

text.p: Citadel Technology Inc said Tuesday it expected second quarter sales to be down from a year earlier because the company has abandoned telemarketing as the traditional way of selling its computer software.

"We have shifted from our traditional telemarketing approach to a concentration on resellers and value-added resellers, original equipment manufacturers, and joint venture partners," it said in a statement.
"Although we expect sales to be below last year's levels for at least the next quarter, we are excited about this new sales direction and already are seeing some of the benefits from it," it added.
Citadel, which develops software for network and desktop computers, said the reorganization had also enabled it to cut monthly operating expenses by more than $300,000.
"We are better positioned today than ever with respect to our level of operating expenses, and expect Citadel to be profitable on an operating basis by the fourth fiscal quarter," it said.
Citadel reported a net loss of $0.05 per share on revenues of $492,300 for the first fiscal quarter ended May 31. A year earlier it lost $0.14 a share on revenues of $1.1 million.
The company changed its name to Citadel Technology from Citadel Computer Systems Inc on June 1.
